literal: Deceit clinging to, deeds devoid of nobility they will not do, 'spotless lineage relying on we shall live' those who say.
translation: Those who resolve, 'We shall live by relying on our spotless lineage,' will not perform deeds devoid of nobility, even when motivated by deceit or anger.
modern: குற்றமற்ற குடிப்பிறப்பை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டு வாழ்வோம் என்று நினைப்பவர்கள், வஞ்சனையினாலோ அல்லது கோபத்தினாலோ தகுதிக்கு ஒவ்வாத செயல்களைச் செய்யமாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the self-imposed standards of those born into noble families. People who pride themselves on maintaining the spotless reputation of their lineage ('மாசற்ற குலம்') resolve to live strictly by those high standards. Consequently, even when faced with situations that provoke deceit, anger, or hostility ('சலம்'), they will never stoop to performing actions that lack dignity or nobility ('சால்பில'). Their commitment to their family's honor acts as a shield against unethical behavior.
